findings.defect: Article-level iPad/Windows/macOS platform set is inherited by iPad-specific operations. Desktop is mentioned for shared credits/preset portability, not as evidence for each tether/capture/storage fact.
findings.impact: False Desktop availability and loss of per-platform operational differences.
findings.correction: Keep frozen review unchanged. New semantic overrides must set these operations to iPad context only; other platforms remain UNKNOWN until separately sourced. Preserve Desktop/iPad scope only for actual credit-sharing and directional preset-portability facts.
findings.check: Assert the listed operation rows have iPad evidence and do not acquire Windows/macOS DOCUMENTED solely from S965.

findings.locator: Subscription Plans; Add-on Packages; Cross-Platform Usage
findings.defect: Mobile subscription offer records inherit iPhone/Android/iPad/Windows/macOS from the credit portability statement. Shared credit use does not prove that all storefronts sell the same offer or grant identical terms.
findings.impact: Conflates purchase eligibility, entitlement use and feature pricing; may conflict with current plan cards.
findings.correction: Represent purchase product/storefront separately from redeemable-device scope. Retain historical Mobile offer facts with article date/version and current applicability UNKNOWN; do not substitute 60/800 credits for current Desktop plans.
findings.check: Plan purchase platforms and credit-use platforms must be separate fields; verify current region/account storefront before eligibility is CONFIRMED.

findings.locator: Floor Reflection; Presets and Syncing; File Settings
findings.defect: Dedicated flags remain NOT_DOCUMENTED despite prose documenting the precise condition. Floor reflection explicitly supports preset/sync; mask person preset/sync is global, not individual; export format behavior explicitly maps RAW to JPEG.
findings.impact: Machine counts overstate unknowns and can drop known conditions even when evidenceSummary is accurate.
findings.correction: Add evidence-linked semantic overrides for each specific flag. For PHOTO-S603-107, distinguish individual manual selection from unsupported individual-person preset/sync; do not make personSpecific a context-free global boolean.
findings.check: Flag assertions must reproduce the prose condition and cite the same source section; no broad batch/person propagation.

findings.defect: confirmationStatus contains PHOTO_CONFIRMED, VIDEO_CONFIRMED or INFORMATION_CONFIRMED, which are availability/type labels, not the seven required confirmation enums.
findings.impact: Schema consumers can treat type as evidence certainty or reject the dataset.
findings.correction: Preserve raw field in frozen evidence but normalize separate existence, platform, plan and terms statuses in semantic integration. Validate the exact seven enums.
findings.check: No semantic confirmationStatus outside CONFIRMED, CONFIRMED_WITH_PLATFORM_LIMIT, CONFIRMED_WITH_PLAN_LIMIT, CONFIRMED_WITH_CREDIT_CONDITION, CONFLICTING_OFFICIAL_SOURCES, UNKNOWN, NOT_FOUND.

findings.locator: Initial integrator line46: f.creditFreeRequired || f.credit || U
findings.defect: NOT_DOCUMENTED is a truthy string and masks documented f.credit. Measured 163 workflow records are affected.
findings.impact: Known credit amounts/conditions disappear into UNKNOWN; no accurate credit reconciliation or counts.
findings.correction: Select explicitly known values, not merely nonempty strings. Keep free eligibility, export charge and generation charge as independent conditions rather than one coalesced string.
findings.check: Unit test a NOT_DOCUMENTED creditFreeRequired plus known credit text and verify preservation. Test unknown+unknown stays UNKNOWN and a known free condition does not erase a generation charge.

findings.defect: Fallback ignores workflow f.category. Its 458 WORKFLOW records use availability INFORMATION_CONFIRMED and therefore become INFORMATION, then are excluded from controlRows.
findings.impact: Export, project/cloud and preset workflows vanish from candidate totals and platform/credit gate denominators.
findings.correction: Normalize record kind with explicit cohort schema mapping; WORKFLOW must remain an operation. Administrative INFORMATION remains separate and must not inflate photo features.
findings.check: Fixture tests for WORKFLOW export vs INFORMATION subscription vs PHOTO control vs VIDEO_FEATURE. All 458 workflow operations must retain operational kind unless individually reclassified with evidence.

findings.locator: Full cached text; initial integrator line73

findings.locator: credit_current records termsStatus; initial integrator line78
findings.defect: Gate majorUnknownRows only examines control-row confirmationStatus. It omits severe policy termsStatus UNKNOWN; especially CC06/CC07 have confirmed rule existence with unknown detailed terms and no CONFLICTING status.
findings.impact: Severe unknown count can understate blockers even while overall status remains hard-coded BLOCK.
findings.correction: Maintain separate severePolicyUnknown and severePolicyConflict counts, with record IDs. Confirmed existence must not overwrite UNKNOWN terms.
findings.check: All five severe records with termsStatus UNKNOWN remain visible; CC06/CC07 cannot disappear because their existence is confirmed.

findings.defect: iPad source explicitly says these subsliders activate only after Amount is adjusted. Review records list independent adjustment but omit the activation dependency from facts/notes.
findings.impact: Operation-flow parity can be misread as six always-active sliders; a heading disposition does not prove every constraint was retained.
findings.correction: Add per-option activationRequires Amount-adjusted condition with source locator. Do not inherit it to Mobile unless its own source states it.
findings.check: Each affected iPad row links to its Amount prerequisite; control discovery tests include disabled/enabled state.

findings.defect: Article-level PHOTO_FEATURE class labels Favorites organization and global Undo workflow facts as photo-feature records.
findings.impact: Mixes editing controls, workflow operations and feature inventory totals.
findings.correction: Reclassify operational record kind in semantic overlay while preserving actual availability and all restart/unsupported-action constraints. Do not promote release-note administrative text into controls.
findings.check: Photo-control counts exclude workflow organization/history rows; workflow coverage still includes them.

findings.locator: Older subscription/iPad FAQ; App Store3.2.5 history; Japan unlimited-plan notice
findings.defect: Current policy conflict source set does not include S21313 or S965, so the source-ID/keyword integrator cannot attach CC04 to the old Mobile/iPad export-only claims. The old facts remain source-confirmed without their current-applicability conflict.
findings.impact: A consumer may reuse historical 'all editing free/each export1credit' or Desktop-only benefit claims as current Mobile policy.

findings.check: Old FAQ credit rows display the current-policy issue; unrelated FAQ tether/preset facts do not become conflicts.

findings.locator: AI Iris Correction, Notes after Feature details
findings.defect: Article uncertainty retains an unquantified angle range, but per-option records omit the explicit strong-side-profile failure caveat. Generic notes only say guarantees unknown.
findings.impact: Feature extraction preserves controls but loses a known operational limitation needed for identity/quality comparison.
findings.correction: Attach the supported-angle/strong-side-profile caveat to the AI Iris operation family; keep numerical range UNKNOWN.
findings.check: No invented angle value, universal success, identity guarantee or batch support; constraint survives deduplication.

findings.defect: Index coverage gate only compares the original261 acquired hrefs and ignores26 newly discovered unacquired routes preserved by index_reverse. These include22 possible English article routes and4 malformed routes.
findings.impact: A zero acquired-link remainder can be mistaken for complete reverse reconciliation despite a larger discovered universe.
findings.correction: Retain the original261 denominator and separately add discoveredRouteOpen count, IDs, route kinds and disposition. Do not infer canonical destination from suspectedArticleId or navigation label.
findings.check: A synthetic/new unresolved route must keep reverse reconciliation OPEN even if every original href is resolved. Once destination is acquired, retain alias/current-source evidence and close only that route.
